pendingCard.title: Please check what will be built
pendingCard.question:
This is a verification run: the app is to be checked exactly as it is today, with no behaviour, screen, setting or data change. The only deliverable is evidence that the current app starts, its existing automated tests pass, and nothing in the project was modified by the check. The earlier sign-in/Identity decisions belong to a separate feature and are not part of this change.

Are these right? Approve them, or tell me in your own words what to change.
context: R1: The app is left exactly as it is: no application file, setting, schema or stored data is changed, and the existing automated tests and start-up behaviour still pass.
Assumed for you: The earlier decisions about Identity, roles and Google sign-in belong to a different feature and are not part of this verification request.
Not included: Any change to sign-in, roles, Google sign-in, teammates, or environment settings
Not included: Fixing problems the verification finds
Not included: Adding new tests, scripts or scaffolding
